conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Hello. Could you tell me your age and gender, and what brings you in today?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I'm 58 years old, male. I came in because I've been having some back pain since Saturday morning. I think I strained my lower back when I helped my daughter lift some heavy boxes. It felt like something popped, and I had to lie down for a while before the pain eased up a bit. It's been stiff ever since.
